entities.name: Draginja Vuksanović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Draginja Vuksanović-Stanković is a Montenegrin jurist, politician and professor of law at the University of Montenegro. She is former member of Parliament and the former president of the Social Democratic Party. At the 2018 presidential election, she became the first female presidential candidate in the history of the country, and also appeared in 2023 presidential election campaign.
